scenario.goal_zh: 凭颜色和独特修补痕迹确认手套归属并领取

context_zh: 莫在泳池前台询问当天遗失的一只手套。
author: author-phase05-c

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: Has anyone handed in a grey glove this afternoon? I seem to have lost my right one.

sentences.speaker: Fran
sentences.text: We have two here. Can you describe anything unusual about yours?

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: There is a small repair near the thumb, sewn with bright green thread.

sentences.speaker: Fran
sentences.text: This one has that repair. Is the matching one in your bag?

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: Yes, here it is. They are the same colour and size.

sentences.speaker: Fran
sentences.text: That is a match. Here you are.

sentences.speaker: Mo
sentences.text: Thank you. I will put both of them in my bag this time.
